bio.text: Nathalia Fernandez is a Democratic member of the New York State Senate for District 34, in office since January 1, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Before the Senate she served in the State Assembly (District 80) from 2018 to 2023; in August 2022 the Bronx Times identified her as an Assemblymember running for the 34th Senate District.
Earlier she worked as an executive coordinator and chief of staff to Assemblymember Mark Gjonaj and as a Bronx regional representative in Gov. Andrew Cuomo's office.
She earned a B.A. in public relations from Hofstra University in 2010.
